messages:
Marie: Hey team — I sketched a lightweight PRD + doc-driven quickstart for the new "embedding-fastpath" initiative. Wanted to align on acceptance criteria and rollback rules before I mark this ready for drafts.
Ashwin: Thanks — can you paste the ACs inline? quick summary is fine.
Marie: Sure. Top-level ACs: 1) Quickstart reproduces example end-to-end in <3 min from signup -> first embedding; 2) README includes explicit cost/latency expectations for small (<1k tokens) vs medium (1k-10k) workloads; 3) SDK snippet (python/js) runs with defaults and includes retry/backoff example; 4) Migration note for existing customers (how to pin old model variant); 5) Rollback: feature toggle + safe-fallback to earlier model variant within 5m on errors >1% request-failure.
Jordan: Nice. For (1) do we mean wall-clock from blank org to first call? what infra assumptions (hosted only)?
Marie: Good Q — target is hosted API + self-serve plan only for the quickstart. We should add a note: dedicated/private requires extra setup and excluded from the <3 min metric.
Sam: On rollback: what counts as "errors >1%"? 5xx only or also quality regressions? We should differentiate telemetry triggers vs human ops triggers.
Lee: Ops suggestion: have two trigger streams. Automated: 5xx rate and token latency spike (95p). Manual: quality regression alert from eval harness or customer complaint. Auto triggers should open a canary rollback runbook.
Marie: I'll update AC: automated rollback triggers on 5xx >=1% over 5m OR 95p token latency >2x baseline for 10m. Manual rollback can be initiated by SRE or PM via the Console; include exact rollback steps in the runbook.
Ashwin: For the SDK snippet, include small snippet showing batch_embeddings and an example of chunking to avoid OOM. Maybe add a code fence.
Marie: Added example: ```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = cli.embeddings.create(model='rw-embed-v1', input=['short doc'])
print(resp[0]['embedding'][:8])
# note: for >10k tokens chunk input and stream results
```
Jordan: Edgecases: what if model variant not available in region? Quickstart should auto-fallback to closest compatible model and show a warning banner in Console and quickstart docs.
Sam: Also include an acceptance test: automated CI job that runs the quickstart steps against a staging org once per day and fails PRs if samples change shape (schema or token size).
Marie: Added AC for daily canary job + GitHub check. DocsBot: @DocsBot can you attach the current quickstart template to this thread?
DocsBot: Attached: templates/quickstarts/embedding-fastpath.md (v3) — link https://internal.redwood/templates/embedding-fastpath.md :ok_hand:
Lee: TL;DR: ready to move to RFC if we: (a) add dedicated/private exclusions, (b) add automated canary + rollback runbook ref, (c) include SDK chunking sample and CI check.
Marie: Agreed. I'll update the PRD and drop a short RFC in #eng-runtime tomorrow for implementation estimates. Thanks all — please drop any missing edge cases now. :raised_hands:
